issues.title: Ambiguous 'git pull' failure handling in runner
issues.why: The runner contract (02-runner-contract.md) says 'warn but continue on failure' for git pull during slides build, but doesn't specify if the exit code should reflect this partial failure.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that a failed 'git pull' emits a warning to stderr but MUST NOT change the final exit code if the build succeeds.

issues.title: Missing units for timeout in install-contract
issues.why: 01-install-contract.md mentions a '2s timeout' for probing newer repos but doesn't specify if this is a total timeout or per-request timeout.
issues.fix: Clarify: '2s total wall-clock timeout for the parallel probe operation'.

issues.title: Missing sample for checksums.txt content
issues.why: While the format is described as 'sha256sum standard', a concrete 2-line example would prevent 'one vs two spaces' implementation errors by mediocre coders.
issues.fix: Add a code block to 03-release-pipeline.md showing: 'e5b0...  install.sh\n6f21...  install.ps1'.
